meta.description: Hangs gills under a cap: the stripes of a pattern become plates or ridges on the underside of the cap's flesh, from the stipe to the margin. They follow the cap as it opens or changes shape. Adds them to a mesh in a material group of their own.

mesh.label: Body
mesh.description: The mesh the gills are added to, the cap and stipe from hyphae_to_mesh

cap.description: The rays of a cap node, the gills hang from the underside of their flesh

hinge.description: The hinge of the same cap node

pattern.description: Stripes from a reaction_diffusion node, its inner radius lands where the cap leaves the stipe and its radius on the margin

stipe.description: The stipes the cap grows on, decurrent gills run down along them. Without them they run straight down from the hinge.

form.description: Thin plates with a rounded edge like the gills of a field mushroom, or blunt folds as wide as they are deep like the ridges of a chanterelle

depth.description: How far the gills reach down from the cap where they are deepest

depth_curve.label: Depth to the margin
depth_curve.description: How deep the gills are from the stipe (left) to the margin (right), as a share of the depth

thickness.description: Thickness of a gill where it meets the cap. Ridges are at least as wide as they are deep.

free_distance.description: Gap between the stipe and the gills, along the underside. 0 lets them reach the stipe.

decurrent.description: How far the gills that reach the stipe run down along it, getting lower. Only without a free distance.

edge_wave.description: How much the edges of the gills wave sideways, 1 by half a gill spacing

irregularity.description: How much depth and thickness vary between neighbouring gills and along them

forking.description: Share of the gills that end close to a neighbour which join it: a short gill forks off a long one, two side by side join with a cross vein
